title: Brush Washer
content: Here's an easy and cheap way of making a brush washer for oil painting using a glass jar and a plastic container, with kerosene as the solvent. The holes in the plastic container are made with a power drill and a 1/4 inch high speed drill.After the jar fills up with sediment it can be discarded at the recycling center on toxic waste day.Also check out the GJ post on Ed Ahlstrom's design for a coffee can brush washer,link.
